p: Every kill drops 3 extra gold, but each swing that misses deducts 2 gold from your pouch.
Recovered from the burned toll house at the Sunken Ford. Collector Vance kept his books balanced in ink until the highland raiders arrived, and in marrow thereafter.
Recovered from the burned toll house at Sunken Ford.
Collector Vance kept his books in ink until raiders came, and in marrow after.
Grants +25% movement speed in water or mud, but leaves a loud squelching trail that increases enemy aggro range by 3 tiles.
Scout Bren swore he lost its twin in the willow sinks east of Ravenwatch. In truth, he traded it to a bog hermit for three dry biscuits and a map that was mostly lies.
Scout Bren swore he lost its twin in the willow sinks east of Ravenwatch.
In truth, he traded it for three dry biscuits and a lying map.
Fire spells deal +20% damage, but standing in water extinguishes the wand for 6 s, reducing spell damage by 15%.
Carved from bleached alder wood and dipped in rendered tallow from the Ravenwatch crypts. Mordred the Ashen used it to light rituals where dry kindling refused to catch.
Bleached alder dipped in crypt tallow that lights where dry kindling fails.
Blocks 40% of ranged projectile damage, but burns for double duration when hit by fire.
A three-inch slab of seasoned iron-oak pried from the shattered inner portcullis of Ravenwatch Keep. Three broken iron arrowheads are still wedged in the grain.
Iron-oak pried from Ravenwatch's portcullis, still studded with arrowheads.
Every 4th arrow pins the target's shadow to the dirt, rooting them for 2.5 s.
Quartermaster Tarn confiscated forty such bows from Greywood poachers before the war. When the border collapsed, he handed them back with instructions to shoot anything wearing furs.
Confiscated from Greywood poachers, then reissued to shoot anything in furs.
Hits against armored or stone targets deal +35% crushing damage and reduce their armor by 2 for 5 s.
Bound with quarry-chain and weighted with a chunk of enchanted granite chipped from Krag Ironhide's left knee. It is unsubtle, poorly balanced, and thoroughly persuasive.
Weighted with chipped granite from a troll's knee; unsubtle and persuasive.
While below 35% HP, your movement speed increases by 30%, but you cannot cast offensive spells.
Courier Corin swallowed this signet ring twice during the siege of Lantern Passage to keep it from the Ravine Warden. He politely declined to wear it again afterward.
Courier Corin swallowed this signet twice at Lantern Passage to save his orders.
Emits a loud metallic chirping whenever poison clouds are within 6 tiles, granting +15% accuracy to nearby allies.
Worn by the deep-sappers who cleared the Undervault Links. There is no bird inside the iron crest anymore—only a bound marsh-wisp that shrieks when the air turns sour.
A bound marsh-wisp inside the crest shrieks whenever mine air turns sour.
When struck in melee, weaves a brittle silk thread that slows the attacker by 30% for 4 s.
Cut from the calcified silk-gland of Morvessa beneath the Weeping Ossuary. It remains unpleasantly sticky in humid weather and attracts cellar spiders.
Cut from Morvessa's calcified silk-gland; still clammy in damp weather.
Drinking a Healing Draught also restores 25 mana, but inflicts a 3 s coughing fit that reduces accuracy by 4.
Half-full of Redmarsh brackish water and cheap apricot spirit. It tastes of rust and dead beetles, yet men have killed their brothers at Highgate Watch for a single swallow.
Tastes of rust and dead beetles, yet men killed for a sip at Highgate Watch.
Every critical hit steals 8 mana from the target and infects them with 4 poison damage per second for 6 s.
Hexer Kaelen maintained that bloodletting cured all frontier complaints, particularly the complaint of imperial soldiers standing upright in his desert.
Hexer Kaelen claimed bloodletting cured enemy soldiers of standing upright.
Every 4th hit releases a shockwave of ironstone dust that blinds enemies in a 2-tile radius for 3 s.
Wielded by the head convict of the Deep Quarry during the terrace uprising. The iron chain wrapping the haft is still stamped with his prison serial number.
Its iron-wrapped haft still bears the convict leader's quarry serial number.
Casting an Air or Earth spell discharges a static arc to the nearest foe within 5 tiles for 18 lightning damage.
Chipped from the northern wardstone during the great dust-rupture. It smells permanently of scorched sand and makes the bearer's hair stand on end before rain.
Chipped from the north monolith; smells of scorched sand and static storm.
Reduces movement speed by 8%, but makes the bearer completely immune to knockback and stun effects.
When the fourth munitions wagon broke its axle in the Redmarsh mire, Quartermaster Bram bolted a leather strap to the iron-rimmed wheel and told his sergeant to stop complaining.
Quartermaster Bram strapped leather to a broken wagon wheel and called it armor.
Moving away from enemies grants +20% speed and +4 mana regen, but moving toward them reduces your armor by 2.
Taken from Commander Vorn's baggage train in Spearwind Gorge. His officers called it a rout; his memoirs, left unfinished in the saddlebag, called it 'an aggressive rearward realignment.'
Vorn's officers called it a rout; his memoirs called it rearward realignment.
Grants +100% resistance to poison and disease, but increases all fire damage taken by 35%.
Unwound from a three-century-old magistrate in the salt tombs below Redmarsh. The bitumen preservative keeps out marsh-rot wonderfully, provided one stays far from open torches.
Bitumen-soaked burial cloth that keeps out rot if kept far from open flame.
Arrows fired from more than 6 tiles away split into a shimmering heat-haze, hitting a second target for 50% damage.
Laminated from dried dune-beast horn and sinew cured in alkaline brine. Looking along the arrow-shelf for too long induces a mild, pleasant hallucination of cold beer.
Sinew-cured horn that makes archers hallucinate cold ale along the arrow-shelf.
Absorbs the first 15 points of damage from any poison or acid attack and converts it into 10 HP.
Hacked from the third stomach of Gorrathul alongside six rusted belt buckles, a brass astrolabe, and the guild-signet of a missing spice caravan.
Hacked from Gorrathul's third stomach beside six buckles and a guild signet.
Critical hits inflict a bleeding wound for 8 damage/s over 5 s and heal the nearest injured ally for 20 HP.
'Hold him down and give him the leather strap to bite. If he dies of shock, at least he won't die of gangrene.' — Chief Healer Sera, during the third night at the woodland infirmary.
Bite the leather strap; dying of shock beats dying of marsh gangrene.
Attackers striking you in melee take 9 physical thorn damage from the razor-sharp sea barnacles.
Worn by the Sunken Citadel's castellan, who refused to abandon the lower guardroom even after the winter tides permanently claimed the ground floor.
Worn by a castellan who refused to leave even after winter tides took the floor.

title: The Baron's Cooking-Ledger Ring
summary: Unique Ring of the Scribe · Any

p: Shop prices in towns are reduced by 15%, but enemies focus their attacks on you first as if you owed them back-pay.
The rogue baron of Oakhaven kept two signet rings: one for signing imperial tax charters, and this one for transferring garrison pension funds into his private catacombs.
Oakhaven's baron kept this second seal solely to siphon garrison pensions.
Fires heavy iron bolts that pierce through the first target to hit a second foe behind them for 75% damage.
When Gate Warden Lyra ran out of standard cedar quarrels during the Hourglass siege, her engineers began loading iron door-hinges and broken jail keys into the windlass.
When cedar bolts ran dry, Warden Lyra's crew loaded iron hinges and jail keys.
Every 5th hit knocks the target backward 2 tiles and stuns them for 2 s.
Fourteen pounds of drop-forged Oakhaven iron designed to turn the rusted floodgate gears of Riverlock Crossing. It turns helmets with equal mechanical leverage.
Drop-forged to turn rusted canal gears; it turns helmets with equal leverage.
Chain Lightning and Thunderstorm jump to 2 additional targets, but each cast shocks the wielder for 6 HP.
Harvested from the charred heartwood of the coastal Stormtree. The wood never truly stopped burning; it merely agreed to wait until pointed at someone else.
Charred coastal heartwood that never stopped burning, only waited for a target.
Increases the reach of all ranged spells by +2 tiles.
Taken from Admiral Kael's charred cabin aboard his flagship in Harborwatch. The brass lenses are cracked by heat, yet they still calculate artillery trajectories with cruel precision.
Heat-cracked brass lenses that still reckon broadside arcs with cruel precision.
Whenever your mana drops below 20%, emits a freezing chime that slows all foes within 4 tiles for 4 s (30 s cooldown).
A salt-eaten bronze pendulum salvaged from the flooded bell-tower of the Sunken Citadel. Even on dry land, it swings slightly in rhythm with the coastal tide.
Salvaged from the flooded nave; it still swings in rhythm with coastal tides.
Spells drain 5 mana from every enemy hit and restore it to the caster.
One of the smaller bone pipes from Vesperion's dorsal cathedral organ. When swung through the air, it produces a flat, liturgical F-sharp that makes dogs weep.
A bone pipe from Vesperion's organ whose flat F-sharp makes watchdogs weep.

title: Malrik's Margin-Notes
summary: Unique Eye of the Cosmos · Mage

p: Reduces all spell cooldowns by 20%, but 15% of all damage taken is subtracted from your Mana before HP.
Bound in the fire-cured hide of a highland drake. Arch-Mage Malrik's handwriting begins in neat academic script and degenerates over three hundred pages into frantic geometric diagrams.
Malrik's neat Collegium notes degenerate into frantic caldera diagrams.
Reduces damage from area-of-effect explosions and boulders by 45%.
Captain Rowan took a glancing blow from a basalt catapult stone on the third day at Greystone Bastion. His neck was never straight again, which he claimed improved his posture on parade.
Dented by a basalt stone at Greystone; Rowan claimed it improved his posture.
Every 3rd hit brands the target with white-hot slag, dealing 15 fire damage/s for 4 s and melting 3 armor.
Still glowing dull cherry-red at the core. If left on a wooden table in Ironcamp, it burns its way through to the floorboards before the ale goes flat.
Still cherry-red at the core; it chars oak tables before the ale goes flat.
Arrows shatter into volcanic glass on impact, dealing 30% of their damage in a 2-tile cone behind the target.
Ribbed with flexible strips of crimson obsidian taken from a Redglass Drake's wing-spar. Drawing the string without heavy leather gauntlets is a quick way to lose three fingers.
Ribbed with crimson obsidian that slices bare fingers on a careless draw.

title: Portcullis of the First Checkpoint
summary: Unique Aegis of the Citadel · Warrior

p: While standing completely still, you gain +5 armor and reflect 25% of ranged damage back at the shooter.
Carried through the Gauntlet of Iron by a vanguard sergeant who died standing upright, wedged so tightly between two basalt boulders that the enemy had to climb over him.
Its bearer died wedged upright in the pass so his company could climb over.
Leaves a trail of burning embers as you walk that deals 10 fire damage/s to pursuing enemies, but burns you for 2 HP/s while standing still.
Forged without leather linings so they would never catch fire in the lava trenches of the Outer Rampart. The soldiers who wore them learned never to stop marching.
Forged without leather linings so soldiers in lava trenches never stopped marching.
Deals +25% damage to bosses and elite monsters, and executes non-boss enemies below 12% HP instantly.
An ancient coronation greatsword whose royal crest was chiseled off with a cold iron punch. It weighs as much as a wet sack of salt and cuts like a broken treaty.
Coronation steel with its royal crest chiseled off; cuts like a broken treaty.

title: Signet of the Two Paths
summary: Unique Signet of Unbroken Vigor · Any

p: When HP is above 50%, grants +15% spell damage; when HP is below 50%, grants +15% physical damage and +8% lifesteal.
Found upon the stone threshold before the Crown Vault. One half of the bezel is set with cold celestial silver, the other with slag from the Obsidian Throne.
One half set in cold silver, the other in slag from the Obsidian Dais.

title: Cinder-King's Halberd-Horn
summary: Unique Medallion of the Celestial Spire · Any

p: Every 5th spell or weapon attack unleashes a ring of volcanic fire around you for 38 fire damage.
A molten iron sword-tip broken from the blazing halo above Ashkarath's brow. Even suspended on a heavy chain, it pulls slightly toward the center of the earth.
A molten horn-tip from Ashkarath's halo that pulls toward the earth's core.
Silent draw wrapped in oiled otter-pelt.
Stripped from a border poacher who fed three Thornwick taverns on crown venison before the bridge wardens caught him.
Silent draw wrapped in oiled otter-pelt for wet reed-beds.
Horn-tipped limbs notched for bridge-post distance markers.
Issued to Redmarsh toll-marksmen who collected tariffs from forty paces across the dry salt-beds.
Horn-tipped limbs notched for exact bridge-post distance markers.
Sinew-backed limbs lacquered against coastal squalls.
Carried by Fen-Warden Hale through forty dust storms without a single warped nock or snapped string.
Sinew-backed limbs lacquered thick against Redmarsh squalls.
Steel prod stamped with Oakhaven's customs anchor.
Spanned with a belt-hook to punch iron quarrels clean through smuggler hull-planks at low tide.
Heavy steel prod stamped with Oakhaven's customs anchor.
Six-foot stave whose string hums in volcanic updrafts.
Strung with braided wire from the shattered beacons; arrows loosed from it scream like falling slag.
Six-foot stave whose string hums in rising volcanic updrafts.
Dyed in bog-tannin to vanish against wet reeds.
Worn by Fenwick's night-runners who poled contraband past border pickets without rippling the water.
Dyed in dark bog-tannin to vanish against rain-soaked reeds.
Cured cobra-hide riveted with tarnished brass studs.
Stitched by Redmarsh skinners; viper venom beads harmlessly off its overlapping scales.
Cured desert serpent hide riveted with tarnished brass studs.
Crimson canvas lined with spring-steel lames.
Favored by outriders who needed arrow-proof ribs without sacrificing speed on loose scree.
Crimson sail-canvas lined inside with spring-steel lames.
Pebbled redglass hide that sheds sparks like rain.
Cut from a fallen drake on the Iron Coast cliffs; smells faintly of sulfur and wet ash.
Pebbled redglass drake hide that sheds furnace sparks like rain.
Iridescent scales bound with dried wyrm-sinew.
As light as boiled leather yet capable of turning aside a Dread Knight's halberd.
Iridescent caldera scales bound tight with dried wyrm-sinew.
Soft elkhide soles that leave no print in wet clay.
Laced crosswise by Greywood trappers who stalked wolves across thin winter ice.
Soft elkhide soles stitched to leave no print in wet river clay.
Wing-stamped boots light as dried gull feathers.
Enchanted in Oakhaven for dispatch runners outpacing coastal cavalry along narrow sea-cliffs.
Wing-stamped scout boots light as dried gull feathers.
Grooved ox-horn guard polished smooth by bowstrings.
Prevents string-slap during rapid volleys in freezing Border Fords sleet.
Grooved ox-horn armguard polished smooth by a thousand releases.
Pitch-dark kidskin with lead-weighted knuckles.
Issued to Baron Vane's night-scouts for scaling wet stone walls without a sound.
Pitch-dark kidskin gloves hiding lead-weighted knuckles.
Steeped ebon hide fitted with a smoked-quartz monocle.
Cuts desert salt-glare and volcanic ash haze, letting marksmen pick visor slits at max range.
Steeped ebon hide fitted with a smoked-quartz assay monocle.
Narrow off-hand blade built for finishing pinned foes.
Carried by Redmarsh archers when sand-raiders get past the snares into arm's reach.
Narrow off-hand poignard built for finishing pinned quarrymen.
Notched with forty-seven unpaid pauper-liens.
Whittled from a churchyard willow; still smells of damp tallow and wet ink.
Notched along the shaft with forty-seven unpaid pauper-liens.
Graveyard heartwood rubbed with sea-salt and ash.
Used by coastal scriptorium clerks to witness sailors' dying vows over open water.
Graveyard yew heartwood rubbed dry with sea-salt and hearth-ash.
A preserved bog-beetle gleams inside the resin knob.
Binds lingering spirits to their unfinished contracts until every hour of labor is repaid.
A preserved bog-beetle gleams inside its fossilized resin knob.
Hexagonal quartz darkened by decades of incense soot.
Draws residual vigor from fallen combatants to mend fractured bone servants.
Hexagonal quartz darkened by decades of ossuary incense soot.
Inlaid with tarnished brass rings stamped with watch-numbers.
Carried by the First Watch arbiter who cataloged the frozen oaths beneath the Threshold.
Inlaid with tarnished brass rings stamped with First Watch numbers.
Charred at the tip from swinging iron censers.
Balanced for long marches along muddy border roads where unmarked graves outnumber milestones.
Charred at the ferrule from swinging heavy iron abbey censers.
Coiled roots that tighten near spilled blood.
Cut from the Night Orchards above Oakhaven; murmurs the names of unburied soldiers.
Coiled ash roots that tighten slightly near freshly spilled blood.
Threadbare black wool patched with grey linen.
Worn by Thornwick's lower-parish clerks during winter plague tallies.
Threadbare black wool patched at the hem with pauper-roll linen.
Loomed with fine copper threads to shed static.
Keeps mortuary scribes safe when auditing wardstone ruins during Redmarsh squalls.
Loomed with fine copper threads to bleed off stray ley static.
Treated with funerary pitch to repel rot and vermin.
Taken from a Third-Dynasty crypt gallery where embalmers guarded rows of sealed jars.
Treated with funerary bitumen to repel marsh rot and vermin.
Heavy burgundy pile trimmed with ash-grey fur.
Worn by inheritance judges of the old pale who cross-examined dead testators in court.
Heavy burgundy pile trimmed with ash-grey coastal wolf fur.
Stitched with silver thread tracing forgotten constellations.
Arrows seem to hesitate before striking cloth woven for the Threshold's silent keepers.
Stitched with silver thread tracing forgotten Anchor constellations.
Folded ash-linen hood smelling of gall-ink and sage.
Muffles battlefield clamor so the wearer can hear quiet debts spoken from the dust.
Folded ash-linen hood smelling faintly of oak-gall ink and sage.
Tarnished balance-pans suspended from a quartz beam.
Weighs every ounce of borrowed sinew against the blood owed in return.
Tarnished balance-pans hung from a chiseled quartz beam.
Bone-framed silver disc corroded by harbor brine.
Reflects lingering spirits trapped along the Iron Coast reefs.
Bone-framed silver disc pitted by years of Oakhaven harbor brine.
Carved from a yellow knuckle-bone stamped with a tax-mark.
Grows ice-cold whenever an enemy attempts to flee an unsettled contract.
Carved from a yellow knucklebone stamped with a bailiff's mark.
Notched edge ground bright on river flagstones.
Held the eastern abutment of Alder Bridge through three waves of gnoll shield-breakers.
Notched broadsword ground bright on wet river flagstones.
Iron-banded ash haft wedged with quarry steel.
Used by freed Deep Quarry miners to crack the kneecaps of stone sentinels.
Iron-banded ash haft wedged tight with fractured quarry steel.
Undulating blade darkened with forge-soot.
Vibrates violently against parrying pikes, tearing shields out of numb hands.
Undulating siege blade darkened permanently with caldera soot.
Square-tipped greatsword stamped with dry-well tallies.
Carried by Ironheart's gate-warden who starved a valley to guard empty silt.
Square-tipped greatsword stamped with Gorrathul's dry-well tallies.
Six feet of meteoric iron weeping banked ember.
Forged in Ironcamp's floor-fissures to cleave through Dread Knight plate.
Six feet of meteoric star-iron weeping banked caldera ember.
Scorched oak planks bolted to meteoric slag.
Stopped forty arbalest bolts in a single morning without splitting a single iron strap.
Scorched oak planks bolted onto plates of meteoric slag.
Rippled black steel quenched in volcanic brine.
Turns a veteran infantryman into a walking redoubt at the cost of every copper in his purse.
Rippled black steel quenched in Ironcamp's sulfur brine.
Dented nasal bar scarred by demonic catapult shrapnel.
Kept Captain Rowan breathing when the eastern curtain wall buckled under siege.
Dented nasal bar scarred by hot caldera catapult shrapnel.
Inlaid glyphs copied from corrupted plumbing diagrams.
Proves that state liturgy and basic thermodynamics obey the exact same pressure laws.
Inlaid runes copied from banned thermodynamic conduit diagrams.
Ashwood shaft wound tight with galvanic copper wire.
Originally calibrated to test silver coins for clipping; works even better on plate armor.
Ashwood shaft wound tight with galvanic Border Mint copper wire.
Milky crystal core humming at teeth-rattling pitch.
Chipped from a Redmarsh climate wardstone before the blood-chanters cracked it open.
Milky crystal core humming at a teeth-rattling telluric pitch.
Salt-corroded brass rings turning toward southern straits.
Salvaged from Vesperion's burning flagship; points unerringly toward volcanic ley-vents.
Salt-corroded brass rings locked due south toward the straits.

title: Threshold Keystone Eye
summary: Unique Eye of the Cosmos · Mage

p: Slit-pupiled gem floating inside blackened gold.
Reveals the pressure valves binding Crown and Ember before the final seal breaks.
Slit-pupiled gem floating coldly inside blackened threshold gold.
Midnight felt lined with copper grounding wire.
Prevents static backfire when channeling Chain Lightning in coastal rainstorms.
Midnight felt lined inside with copper grounding wire.
Interlocking silver crescents cradling a cold diamond.
Settles icy clarity behind the eyes even when ash-storms blot out the sky.
Interlocking silver crescents cradling a cold, unflawed diamond.
Crimson gloves stitched with grounded brass eyelets.
Keeps finger-joints from blistering when venting high-voltage arcs at close quarters.
Crimson velvet gloves stitched with grounded brass eyelets.
Notched along the spine from parrying river-raider boarding axes.
Carried by the last sergeant who held the southern pier of Alder Bridge until the spring flood washed away his garrison's pay-chest.
Notched along the spine from parrying raider boarding axes.
Swollen oak boards banded with an iron wagon-tire.
Hammered together by a Thornwick miller who defended his granary door against six starving deserters with nothing else in hand.
Swollen oak mill boards banded with an iron wagon-tire.
Triple-greased hide that sheds cold creek-water like duck feathers.
Worn by border scouts who spent three winters mapping every gravel bar between Thornwick and the upper fens.
Triple-greased hide that sheds cold creek-water like duck down.
Twisted sinew cord rubbed with beeswax against morning mist.
Recovered from a hollow willow trunk where an outlawed forester hid his fletching tools from the baron's bailiffs.
Twisted sinew cord rubbed with beeswax against morning river mist.
Stitched from briar-hound hide so thick even blackthorns slide off.
Tailored by a border trapper who crawled belly-flat through half a league of brambles to scout a brigand camp.
Stitched from briar-hound hide so thick blackthorns slide off.
Calloused river-hide molded to the exact curve of a bow-stave.
Originally worn by an Alder Ford ferryman who kept a shortbow dry beneath his floorboards for river pirates.
Calloused river-hide molded to the curve of a punt-pole and bow.
Carved with imperial survey notches that glow faintly near ley-water.
Left behind by an academy cartographer who went mad trying to measure the shifting banks of the Redwater.
Carved with survey notches that glow faintly near ley-water.
Bubbled river-sand glass that refracts a single spark into three.
Salvaged from the melted stained-glass window of a roadside shrine torched during the first border tax riots.
Bubbled river-sand glass that splits a single spark into three.
Wide felt brim stiffened with river-clay and old candle wax.
Belonged to an itinerant hedge-mage who taught farmboys their letters in exchange for dry barn-lofts and cider.
Wide felt brim stiffened with river-clay and old candle wax.
Peeled river-willow bound with yellowed catgut and fish-vertebrae.
Used by a Thornwick bone-grinder to coax drowned livestock out of deep mudholes before they spoiled the wells.
Peeled river-willow bound with yellowed catgut and fish-bones.
Hemmed with coarse hemp twine and dusted permanently with quicklime.
Worn by a border parish sexton who buried forty skirmish dead in a single night and swore half of them whispered back.
Hemmed with coarse hemp twine and dusted with parish quicklime.
Whittled from a sheep's knucklebone found beneath the Crooked Willow.
Passed among border deserters as a lucky charm until every man who wore it ended up back at the same crossroads.
Whittled from a sheep's knucklebone found under the Crooked Willow.
Pitted dark iron that holds a vicious, jagged edge in wet peat.
Forged from bog-ore dredged out of Redmarsh trenches to chop through submerged timber barricades during the fen rebellion.
Pitted dark bog-iron that holds a jagged edge in wet peat.
Every iron link boiled in pine-pitch to keep the black rot out.
Stripped from a sunken sentinel whose drowned corpse still stood upright at his post three seasons after the garrison fell.
Every iron link boiled in pine-pitch to keep black rot out.
Slotted near the top so a pikeman can thrust without raising his chin.
Carried by Redmarsh plank-guards who held narrow log causeways against swarms of fever-maddened marsh heretics.
Slotted near the top so a pikeman can thrust without peeking.
Laminated horn limbs wrapped in mottled plague-toad skin.
Favored by fenland guides who hunted bloated bog-beasts from flat-bottomed punts in thick morning fog.
Laminated horn limbs wrapped in mottled plague-toad skin.
Soles pegged with bog-oak spikes that bite cleanly into slick peat.
Cured in bitter willow-tanning liquor so swamp leeches drop off the leather before reaching the laces.
Soles pegged with bog-oak spikes that bite cleanly into slick peat.
Fine horsehair mesh sewn across the mouth to filter foul marsh-gas.
Worn by Redmarsh bounty hunters tracking heretic preachers through stagnant pools where a deep breath burns the throat.
Fine horsehair mesh sewn over the mouth to filter marsh-gas.
A rusted iron cage at the tip traps a pale, shivering marsh-flame.
Crafted by an exiled scholar who spent seven years bottling swamp-gas spirits until one agreed to burn without fuel.
A rusted iron cage at the tip traps a shivering marsh-flame.
Cloudy river-quartz veined with threads of tarnished bog-copper.
Dredged from the cellar of a sunken abbey where monks once tried to distill clean drinking water from toxic mire.
Cloudy river-quartz veined with threads of tarnished bog-copper.
Stitched with dried wormwood pockets that rattle with every step.
Worn by Redmarsh fever-doctors who walked the quarantine trenches long after the parish priests fled north.
Stitched with dried wormwood pockets that rattle on the march.
Blackened bog-yew inlaid with a sliver of cracked bronze bell-metal.
When tapped against wet stone, it emits a muffled underwater chime that calls half-rotted corpses out of the silt.
Blackened bog-yew inlaid with a sliver of cracked bell-metal.
Linen strips pickled dark brown by centuries beneath acidic peat.
Unwound from a remarkably preserved bog-corpse whose fingers still twitched whenever thunder rolled over Redmarsh.
Linen strips pickled dark brown by centuries under acidic peat.
Tarnished green bronze enclosing a tiny skull carved from marsh-chalk.
Found clutched inside the jaw of a giant plague-toad slain outside the Redmarsh stockade.
Tarnished bronze enclosing a tiny skull carved from marsh-chalk.
Forged from a snapped harbor-boom link studded with shipwright spikes.
Wielded by an Ironcamp dock-captain who smashed through three corsair boarding shields before his own galley sank beneath him.
Forged from a snapped harbor-boom link studded with spikes.
Overlapping whale-oiled plates riveted onto thick seal-hide.
Built for coastal marines who fought knee-deep in freezing surf without letting rust lock their shoulder joints.
Overlapping whale-oiled plates riveted onto thick seal-hide.
Curved steel face hammered with the emblem of a storm-lashed lighthouse.
Stood upright on the Ironcamp sea-wall through twelve winters of pirate broadsides and winter squalls.
Curved steel face hammered with Oakhaven's storm-lashed beacon.
Backed with cured shark-skin that refuses to stretch in wet sea-fog.
Taken from a mutinous crow's-nest marksman who could pick off a helmsman across eighty paces of pitching swell.
Backed with cured shark-skin that refuses to stretch in sea-fog.
Striped with brass strips salvaged from a sunken royal pay-frigate.
Worn by cliff-scavengers who climbed wet basalt chimneys with quivers strapped tight against the gale.
Striped with brass salvaged from a sunken royal pay-frigate.
Braided hemp soles stitched over oiled calfskin for wet kelp-rocks.
Favored by coastal smugglers who outran royal dragoons across razor-sharp tidal reefs at low water.
Braided hemp soles stitched over calfskin for wet kelp-rocks.
Charred driftwood spiral-carved with copper lightning-conductors.
Stood atop the Ironcamp cliff-tower during a winter tempest, drinking three lightning strikes without splitting.
Charred driftwood spiral-carved with copper lightning-rods.
Hollow sea-glass orb half-filled with swirling, phosphorescent brine.
Used by coastal navigators to read hidden shoals through thick fog until the tide-cultists stole it for darker auguries.
Hollow sea-glass orb half-filled with swirling, glowing brine.
Salt-stiffened indigo velvet embroidered with silver wave-knots.
Recovered from the locked cabin of a drowned academy envoy bound for the southern provinces.
Salt-stiffened indigo velvet stitched with silver wave-knots.
Polished sea-amber capped with a shard of fossilized leviathan tooth.
Hums like a distant foghorn whenever drowned sailors rise from the surf to answer its call.
